title: Kummer regular-immersion fundamental classes and their operations
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, $n\geq1$, and $\Lambda_n=\mathbf Z/\ell^n\mathbf Z$. For a regular closed immersion $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ of Noetherian schemes on which $\ell$ is invertible, locally of codimension $c\geq0$, use ordinary small-etale derived categories, roots-of-unity twists and the compact-support right adjoints [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], [def-asd-finite-etale-tate-twist], [def-amb-etale-compact-support], [thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint]. Regular means that the ideal is locally generated by a regular sequence [def-weil-closed-immersion], [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence]. There is a canonical supported fundamental class, equivalently a morphism
$$\eta_{i,n}:\Lambda_{n,Z}\longrightarrow i_n^!\Lambda_{n,X}(c)[2c].$$
On an affine chart with regular generators $t_1,\ldots,t_c$, put $Z_k=V(t_1,\ldots,t_k)$ ($Z_0=X$, $Z_c=Z$); the image of $t_k$ on $Z_{k-1}$ cuts out the effective Cartier divisor $Z_k\subset Z_{k-1}$. On this chart $\eta_{i,n}$ is the composite, under the composition rule below, of the $Ri_*\dashv i^!$ transposes of the supported Cartier Kummer maps $c_{Z_k,\Lambda_n}:R(i_k)_*\Lambda_{n,Z_k}\to\Lambda_{n,Z_{k-1}}(1)[2]$ of [lem-asd-ordinary-supported-kummer] for $i_k:Z_k\hookrightarrow Z_{k-1}$. In particular, for $c=1$ the class of an effective Cartier divisor $D$ is the transpose of $c_{D,\Lambda_n}$, whose composite with the unit $\Lambda_{n,X}\to Ri_*\Lambda_{n,D}$ is $+c_1(\mathcal O_X(D))$; this fixes the Kummer sign. This formula is independent of the regular generators and of their order, and determines the global class. For $c=0$ it is the canonical open-and-closed restriction map, with the identity immersion giving $1$.

Under exceptional transitivity and addition of twist-shifts these classes compose: for regular closed immersions $Z\xrightarrow iY\xrightarrow jX$, $\eta_{ji,n}=i_n^!(\eta_{j,n})(c_i)[2c_i]\circ\eta_{i,n}$. They commute with flat base change of pairs, with open restriction, and with localization and strict localization via the canonical continuity identifications of supported etale cohomology. For every $N\geq n$, reduction $\Lambda_N\to\Lambda_n$ carries the supported class $\eta_{i,N}$ to $\eta_{i,n}$. The Tate-line comparison for this reduction is induced by $u\mapsto u^{\ell^{N-n}}$ on roots of unity, with dual tensor comparisons for negative twists.

source.place: Expose XVI, section 2.1 (supported Kummer first Chern class), Definition 2.3.1 and Theorem 2.3.2 (regular-immersion class and composition), Proposition 2.2.3.1 (base change preserving conormal data), section 3.2 before Definition 3.2.2 (local and strict-local restriction), coefficient square in Proposition 3.3.1 and compatible cocycles in Proposition 3.3.2. Continuity is the supported version of Stacks Tag 03Q6 (etale-cohomology.tex, lemma-directed-colimit-cohomology); only affine ind-etale localizations of Noetherian pairs are asserted here.
